 Appearance :
 For the Appellant/s : Mr. Syed Qaisar Hasan, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Ms. Anita Kumari Singh, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Shailendra Singh
 Oral Order

2. This appeal has been preferred against the judgment of conviction dated 2010.2022 and order of sentence dated 21.10.2022 passed by the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-1st, Katihar, in connection with Sessions Trial Case No. 293 of 2019, arising out of Town P.S. Case No. 475 of 2019,
whereby and whereunder the appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 384, 506 and 509 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced for the said offences.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant presses the prayer for bail made by the appellant in the memo of appeal under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.
4.

The main submissions advanced by learned Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.100 of 2023(4)
dt.15-12-2023 counsel for the appellant are that the appellant who is a young person, has been languishing in jail since 26.07.2019 and during trial, the prosecution failed to produce any cogent and reliable evidence to prove the allegation levelled by the victim against the appellant and mainly on the basis of imaginary story the appellant has been convicted and regarding the payment of alleged money no any evidence was gathered by the I.O. nor any evidence was given by the victim Mohammad Arman @ Md. Arman vs The State Of Bihar on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114352805/

sentences.text: in this regard and no one of hotel staff members was examined and the victim did not produce the alleged objectionable video which is alleged to have been recorded by the appellant as such, there is no admissible and cogent evidence against the appellant to justify the appellant's conviction.
Further submission is that there is no chance of early hearing of his appeal.
5. Learned APP has opposed the bail prayer of the appellant.
6. Considering the seriousness of the accusation appearing against the appellant, this court is not inclined to accept appellant's bail prayer.
Accordingly, his bail prayer stands rejected.
7. If the appeal of this appellant is not taken up for hearing in the next one year from the date of this order, then the Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.100 of 2023(4) dt.15-12-2023 appellant may renew his prayer for bail.
8. Registry is directed to take steps to list this appeal, as per seriatum, under the heading "For Hearing" as early as possible.

(Shailendra Singh, J) Rajiv/-
